programs.desc: Because of her honesty, Mila (Yuriska Patricia) becomes Gavin’s (Hardi Fadhillah) secretary. Their unpleasant first meeting makes Gavin determined to force Mila to quit her job. What will Mila’s life be like after becoming Gavin’s secretary?

programs.title: Tolong Naikin Gaji Asisten...
programs.desc: The SCTV FTV Tolong Naikin Gaji Asisten Pembantu Cintanya tells the story of a beautiful young woman named Santi (Jennifer Eve). Santi is willing to take on any honest job to support her family. Her life is ordinary at first, until she suddenly starts working as a personal helper who can handle various tasks. Santi is then hired to help Raza (Fendy Chow) get back together with his ex-girlfriend.

programs.title: Samudra Cinta
programs.desc: The story begins in a simple house, Rusdi with his wife Novi and their three children: Andra, Novan and Vina are chatting in the living room while watching television. Because Vina couldn't sleep, Novi asked Rusdi to turn off the TV. It was then, they just heard the sound of a baby crying that seemed to come from the front of the house. Curious Rusdi and Novi finally put Vina in the baby box and stepped outside to check on the baby. Novi and Rusdi checked to the front and were very surprised to find Lila holding a baby. Lila begs Rusdi to take care of her flesh and blood, which is named Cinta.

programs.title: Istri Satu-Satunya
programs.desc: Soraya disguises herself as a housemaid in the mansion of a wealthy man from her past named Pierre. Her mission is to uncover the dark secrets of her family's history while navigating complex conflicts with the help of Mario.

programs.title: Putri Pewaris
programs.desc: Aina, a college student and promotional model, accidentally gets into a conflict with Darel after posting a video of his actions that goes viral on social media. Unbeknownst to them, Darel is the son of Ferdi, the man who took over Aina’s father’s company and killed him 20 years ago. Their feud becomes even more complicated when an incident nearly forces them to marry, causing their hatred to slowly turn into love. But will their love survive when the dark secrets of both families begin to surface?

programs.title: Cinta Seluas Samudra
programs.desc: Maya is trapped in a fake marriage with Andrian, the heir to a business empire who gradually falls in love with her. However, Hana’s revenge leads Maya to fall into an abyss and she is presumed dead. When Maya is revealed to be alive and in Roni’s hands, a conspiracy makes her believe that Andrian has betrayed her.

programs.title: Wajah Cinta Yang Lain
programs.desc: A single act of betrayal changes Asti's life forever. Stripped of her face, her family, and the life she once believed in, she rises with a new identity to uncover the conspiracy that destroyed everything she held dear. As each hidden truth comes to light, Asti must choose between seeking revenge and fighting for the future of her child—the only reason she continues to live.

programs.title: Biarkan Hati Bicara

Trapped in a family consumed by vengeance, secrets, and hatred, Arina must uncover the truth before it's too late.
